summary: Inside the hovercraft, the metal harness opens and drops the half-conscious Neo onto the floor. Human hands and arms help him up so that he finds himself looking straight at Morpheus. Morpheus smiles and welcomes him, saying "Welcome to the real world, Neo." Neo then passes out.

what_changes.before: Half-conscious, being lowered by the harness and helped up by human hands.
what_changes.after: He has looked at Morpheus, heard the welcome, and passes out.
what_changes.evidence: The metal harness opens and drops the half-conscious Neo onto the floor.

what_changes.before: Unaware of who is there, being helped up.
what_changes.after: He finds himself looking straight at Morpheus, who names him and the real world.
what_changes.evidence: as he finds himself looking straight at Morpheus.

event_hint.one_line: Neo is brought aboard the hovercraft and greeted by Morpheus before passing out.

uncertain: Whether the human hands and arms belong to crew members or to Morpheus.
Whether Neo's passing out is from exhaustion or the transition to the real world.
